name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between them, then hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall, keeping your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back to lower the kettlebell to the floor under control.
image_prompt_scene: Standing over a kettlebell on the floor, hinged, with both hands on the handle.
